metadata.description: Human coding template for the VFA collaborative action scheme (Communicating / Observing / Manipulating / Idle-OffTask / Unclear). Replace participant_descriptions with the AprilTag ids and appearance of your participants; the same descriptions go into config/experiments.yaml for the VLM prompts.

definitions.Communicating: Person is actively communicating with others. This happens when: (1) Looking at work items (screen, documents, hardware) while clearly pointing at those items, OR (2) Looking at another person while gesturing or pointing with hands.
definitions.Observing: Person is watching or monitoring but not actively communicating or manipulating. This happens when: Looking at work items or people, but hands are either resting/inactive, hovering without touching, or touching something different from what they're looking at.
definitions.Manipulating: Person is directly working with something. This happens when: Looking at work items (screen, keyboard, documents, hardware) while at least one hand is clearly touching or contacting the same item they're looking at.
definitions.Idle-OffTask: Person is not engaged in the work task. This happens when: Looking at personal items (phone, snacks) or looking outside the camera frame. Hands can be doing anything.
definitions.Unclear: Cannot tell what the person is doing. This happens when: Cannot clearly see where they're looking or what their hands are doing due to blocking, blur, or poor visibility.
